company.name: Mustadem
company.description: Mustadem is a tech-enabled agribusiness in Saudi Arabia specializing in sustainable agricultural farming. It produces premium fruits, vegetables, and fish using hydroponics, aquaponics, and indoor aquaculture technologies. It also provides agricultural services, consultancy, and fresh food supply to restaurants and consumers. Mustadem is also involved in food value chains sustainability projects, such as insect feed and nanobubbles technologies. Insect feed produces animal feed from insects that can consume organic waste and reduce greenhouse gas emissions and land use. Nanobubbles are tiny bubbles of gas that can improve water quality and oxygen levels in aquaculture systems. These technologies can help Mustadem achieve its vision of transforming the food sector into a more sustainable and transparent industry.
